gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.
'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
The ___ (SAFE) of passengers is our priority.
gaps.explanation: 'Safety' — the quality noun from safe (safe → safety).

gaps.sentence: The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: The city is ___ (FAME) for its architecture.
gaps.explanation: 'Famous for' — 'infamous' means notorious (famous for bad things).
